title: 第3章 收服人心第4章 蜕变之始
content_zh:
后山演武场上，叶凡与叶平相对而立。
叶平嘴角挂着若有若无的讥笑，心想区区一个三重的小子，也敢挑战自己？
即便只用伪装实力，他也有把握在三招内结束战斗。
开始！
随着叶龙一声令下，叶凡身形骤然暴起！
玄气激荡，叶凡周身竟浮现出淡淡的龙形虚影，拳风呼啸间，空气都发出爆鸣声！
什么？！
叶平大惊失色，仓促抬手格挡，却被这一拳震得连退三步。
他骇然发现，叶凡不知道什么时候已经突破到了玄感境第四重，其玄气浑厚程度，甚至堪比五重的修士！
围观的护卫队成员一片哗然。
这...这真是叶凡？
他什么时候变得这么强了？
那功法...从未见过！
叶平眼中闪过一丝慌乱，但很快镇定下来。
他暗自咬牙，将实力提升到六重水准，与叶凡缠斗起来。
场中拳影交错，气浪翻腾。
实力的差距依旧存在，只是几个回合后，叶凡就落入了下风，
只不过叶凡虽落入下风，却越战越勇，招招直取叶平腰间。
三十招过后，叶凡被一掌击退，嘴角溢血。
但他不仅没有沮丧，反而露出胜利的笑容，单膝跪在叶霄尘面前：

少爷，幸不辱命！
说着，将一枚古朴玉佩双手奉上。
叶平脸色骤变，下意识摸向腰间——那里空空如也！
嗡——
失去敛息玉佩的压制，叶平体内澎湃的玄气再难掩饰，玄感境九重的威压轰然爆发！
九...九重？！
叶龙瞪大双眼，随即暴怒：叶平！
你到底是什么人？！
演武场上一片死寂。
所有护卫队成员都震惊地看着这个平日不起眼的，此刻他周身涌动的玄气，竟比队长叶龙还要强横！
叶平面容扭曲，死死盯着叶霄尘：你是怎么发现的？
叶龙这才恍然大悟，原来尘少爷此来，竟是为了揪出奸细！
都看我干嘛？叶霄尘把玩着玉佩，懒洋洋道：奸细都现形了，还不赶紧拿下？
动手！
叶龙一声暴喝，所有护卫同时扑上。
叶平虽实力强横，但双拳难敌四手，很快就被按倒在地。
尘少爷，怎么处置？叶龙请示道。
王厉狞笑道：休想从我口中得到任何情报！
硬骨头啊？叶霄尘轻笑一声，眼神却冷得像冰：本少爷最讨厌动脑筋审问。
我信奉的是——

他缓缓抬手，做了个抹脖子的动作：
直—接—铲—除—
龙哥，杀了吧。
content_en:
In the martial arts field at the back of the mountain, Ye Fan and Ye Ping stood opposite each other.
Ye Ping had a vague sneer on his lips, thinking that a mere third-level boy would dare to challenge him?
Even if he only uses disguised strength, he is sure to end the battle within three moves.
start!
Following Ye Long's order, Ye Fan suddenly rose up!
The mysterious energy surged, and a faint dragon-shaped shadow appeared around Ye Fan. When the wind of the fist roared, the air made an explosion!
What? !
Ye Ping was shocked, and hurriedly raised his hands to block, but was shocked by the punch and took three steps back.
He was shocked to discover that Ye Fan had broken through to the fourth level of the Mysterious Sense Realm at some point, and his profound energy was even comparable to that of a fifth-level monk!
The surrounding escort members were in an uproar.
This...is this really Mark?
When did he become so strong?
That technique... I have never seen it before!
A flash of panic flashed in Ye Ping's eyes, but he quickly calmed down.
He secretly gritted his teeth, raised his strength to the sixth level, and started fighting with Mark.
The fists and shadows intertwined in the field, and the air waves surged.
The gap in strength still existed, but after just a few rounds, Ye Fan fell into a disadvantage.
However, although Ye Fan was at a disadvantage, he became more courageous as he fought, and his moves went straight to Ye Ping's waist.
After thirty moves, Ye Fan was knocked back by a palm and blood flowed from the corner of his mouth.
But instead of being depressed, he showed a victorious smile and knelt on one knee in front of Ye Xiaochen:
Young Master, fortunately you have lived up to your destiny!
As he spoke, he presented an ancient jade pendant with both hands.
Ye Ping's expression suddenly changed, and he subconsciously touched his waist - there was nothing there!
Buzz——
Without the suppression of the breath-holding jade pendant, it was no longer possible to conceal the surging profound energy in Ye Ping's body, and the pressure of the ninth level of the profound sense realm exploded!
Nine...Nine levels? !
Ye Long's eyes widened, and then he became furious: Ye Ping!
Who are you? !
There was dead silence in the martial arts arena.
All the members of the escort team were shocked to see this usually inconspicuous person. At this moment, the profound energy surging around him was actually more powerful than the captain Ye Long!
Ye Ping's face was distorted and he stared at Ye Xiaochen: How did you find out?
Ye Long suddenly realized that Master Chen came here to find out the spy!
Why are you looking at me? Ye Xiaochen played with the jade pendant and said lazily: The spies have revealed themselves, why don't you take them down quickly?
Do it!
Ye Long shouted loudly, and all the guards rushed at him at the same time.
Although Ye Ping was powerful, his two fists were hard to beat with four hands, and he was quickly knocked to the ground.
Master Chen, what should I do? Ye Long asked for instructions.
Wang Li smiled ferociously and said: Don't expect to get any information from me!
Hard-core? Ye Xiaochen chuckled lightly, but his eyes were as cold as ice: I hate using my brain for interrogation.
What I believe in is——
He slowly raised his hand and made a motion of wiping his neck:
Direct - shovel - remove -
Brother Long, kill him.
